title: What Is a POS System? A Practical Guide for Kenyan Businesses
excerpt: A POS system does more than ring up sales. It tracks stock across branches, records every transaction, and tells you what's actually happening in your business. Here's what Kenyan business owners should know before choosing one.

toc.text: What a POS system actually does
What to look for before choosing

faq.a: A POS (Point of Sale) system is the software and hardware used to complete a sale and record what was sold. In modern use, it also tracks stock, staff activity, payments, and reporting across branches.

faq.q: Do I need a POS system for a small shop in Kenya?
faq.a: A single-till shop can work with a simple cash register, but a POS system pays for itself quickly if you sell more than a few hundred items a day, carry stock that expires, or run more than one location.

faq.q: Does a POS system work without internet in Kenya?
faq.a: It depends on the system. Offline-first POS software keeps selling during outages and syncs when the connection returns. Cloud-only systems stop working when the internet is down, which is a real risk in many parts of Kenya.
